boundedQuestion: What is the smallest domain-neutral KaoPuGram envelope that every workbench can emit without letting the universal core guess domain-specific anchor scope or semantics?

realNeed.observation: The user wants one GitHub-hosted KaoPuGram system callable from every workbench when instructed to anchor the current satisfactory part.
realNeed.existingCoverage: R2 pins whole accepted baselines; N305 demonstrated component-scoped digests inside one candidate model.
realNeed.gap: N305 does not define a domain-neutral transport envelope, adapter boundary, ambiguity behavior, or cross-workbench verification contract.
realNeed.regressionDecision: No new regression case. This is a requested protocol design and audition, not a newly evidenced production failure. Existing stale-delivery and no-method-invention cases remain applicable.

teacher.name: Open Container Initiative Image Specification — Content Descriptor and Manifest graph
teacher.exactQuestionAnswered: OCI separates a small interoperable descriptor envelope (mediaType, digest, size, optional artifactType) from the referenced artifact's domain-specific bytes, and manifests link independently typed descriptors in a content-addressed DAG.
teacher.whatItKnowsBeyondCurrentBestView: KAOPU has exact whole-commit identity and an N305 component-manifest Candidate, but no tested cross-domain envelope whose core can verify bytes while remaining ignorant of terrain, garment, hair, animal, or building semantics.

sources.fact: OCI descriptors require mediaType, digest, and size and optionally carry artifactType and annotations.
OCI manifests link descriptors and can associate an artifact with a subject.
The repository includes executable positive and negative descriptor-schema tests.
The official repository remained active with a 2026-10-22 commit.
Latest published release observed during the audition was v1.1.1.

screening.sourceProvenance: Official opencontainers/image-spec repository and OCI specification site.
screening.maintenanceActivity: Repository is not archived; latest observed main commit was 2026-10-22 and latest release was v1.1.1 on 2025-03-03.
screening.runnableCodeTestsData: Public Go types, JSON schemas, and executable positive/negative schema tests are present.
screening.licenseAndRights: Apache-2.0; this Candidate transfers a descriptor design principle and does not copy container assets.
screening.directRelevance: Directly addresses one interoperable envelope for heterogeneous workbench artifacts.
screening.novelty: Adds the universal-core-versus-domain-adapter boundary, explicit type/digest/size descriptors, and unknown-domain behavior beyond N305.
screening.dependencyHardwareCostRisk: The Candidate needs only canonical serialization and hashing; it does not require containers, a registry, GPU hardware, or OCI runtime integration.
screening.demoOnlyOpaqueVersionRisk: Not demo-only or closed: specification, schemas, reference Go types, tests, release artifacts, license, and history are public.

candidateMethod.name: KaoPuGram Universal Anchor Envelope
universalCoreOwns: component descriptors with mediaType, digest, and size
universalCoreMustNotOwn: declaring visual or physical correctness from a digest
silently accepting an unknown or stale adapter

stateSemantics.ANCHOR_CAPTURED_CANDIDATE: Bytes and explicit scope were captured; this is not independent verification, freezing, adoption, or user acceptance.
stateSemantics.HOLD_ANCHOR_SCOPE_UNRESOLVED: No explicit component IDs or valid current workbench selection can resolve the request.
stateSemantics.HOLD_ADAPTER_UNKNOWN: The envelope type is known but no approved adapter can validate its domain semantics.
stateSemantics.HOLD_CONTEXT_STALE: The adapter resolved against a different parent commit or workbench context than the Task Anchor.
stateSemantics.ANCHOR_DESCRIPTOR_VERIFIED: An independent verifier recomputed digest and size for every referenced payload.
stateSemantics.HOLD_DESCRIPTOR_MISMATCH: At least one payload differs from its descriptor.
stateSemantics.REOPENED_BY_USER_OR_COORDINATOR: A previously frozen component is explicitly reopened under a new Task Anchor.

candidateMethod.producerVerifierBoundary: The Producer may emit an ANCHOR_CAPTURED_CANDIDATE but cannot set independentlyVerified, frozenByUser, or userAccepted.

findings: One envelope schema carried a terrain tile and a garment pattern piece.
Each adapter preserved different artifactType, mediaType, semantic role, payload, and excluded components.
An empty active selection was held instead of guessed.
Independent descriptor recomputation passed valid bytes and held tampered bytes.
Capture truth did not claim independent verification, user freezing, or user acceptance.

boundaries: OCI is a methodology teacher only; KaoPuGram does not need container images, OCI registries, or OCI runtime semantics.
A digest and byte size prove payload identity, not visual quality, physics correctness, production readiness, or user satisfaction.
Workbench active selection is acceptable only when bound to the same parent commit and recorded in the Task Anchor; otherwise explicit component IDs are required.
Canonicalization rules must be versioned per adapter or equivalent semantic state may hash differently.
Unknown media types may pass universal syntactic storage but cannot pass domain verification without an approved adapter.
Large binary, LFS, runtime, browser, device, and generated artifacts require payload-level descriptors rather than pointer-file hashes.
An anchor graph must not absorb unrelated workbench state through implicit dependencies.

decision.scope: Candidate-only; historical terrain plus one Garment Mother trial before any common service or OS change.
decision.rollbackPoint: Retain R2 whole-commit Golden Baseline and N305 component manifest Candidate without a universal service if adapters cannot resolve scope deterministically.
